title: Builder Partner Reduction in the Appraisal Order Final Inspection Charge
content:
**Builder partner reduction — Appraisal Order final inspection charge**

The partner-builder reduction of the final inspection charge reads the Builder Partner Credit on the loan file: a verified credit takes off 100 dollars, a reserved credit takes off 50 dollars, and no such credit, or one in any other status, takes off nothing. The credit read is the Larkspur Builder Partner Credit, a Closing Cost Credit, on the Mortgage Loan File the Appraisal Order supports, and its status. The reduction is taken off the final inspection charge, the result never going below zero.

| Larkspur Builder Partner Credit on the loan file | Taken off |
|---|---|
| Status verified | 100.00 dollars |
| Status reserved | 50.00 dollars |
| Any other status | Nothing |
| No such credit on the file | Nothing |

Only the Larkspur Builder Partner Credit counts; another Closing Cost Credit on the same loan file, whatever its status, takes off nothing under this reduction.

*Hypothetical:* a file whose Larkspur Builder Partner Credit moved from reserved to verified: the reduction is 100.00 while the status reads verified; had the status been reserved, 50.00.
